[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/tripadvisor-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/tripadvisor-scraper.md)

Scraper de exemplo que coleta dados do tripadvisor.com, escrito em Python com a API de web scraping do [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Faz parte do [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.pt-BR.md).

- **Guia:** [How to Scrape TripAdvisor.com (2025 Updated)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-tripadvisor)
- **Código:** [`tripadvisor.py`](tripadvisor.py) · **Execução de exemplo:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Testes:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Saída de exemplo:** [Hotel pages](results/hotels.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json) · [Location pages](results/location.json)

## O que ele extrai

- Busca do TripAdvisor para encontrar hotéis a partir de consultas de busca.
  por exemplo, <https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotels-g190311-Malta-Hotels.html>
- Detalhes de anúncios de hotéis do TripAdvisor:
  por exemplo, <https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotels-g190311-Malta-Hotels.html>
    - informações do hotel: descrição, avaliação, recursos etc.
    - preços
    - avaliações

## Funções

- `scrape_location_data(query)` → `List[LocationData]`: scrape search location data from a given query. e.g. "New York" will return us TripAdvisor's location details for this query
- `scrape_search(search_url, max_pages=None)` → `List[Preview]`: scrape search results of a search query
- `scrape_hotel(url, max_review_pages=None)` → `Dict`: Scrape hotel data and reviews

As funções são `async`: execute-as com `asyncio.run(...)` ou use `await`.

### Exemplo

As entradas são os exemplos de [`run.py`](run.py) (listas longas encurtadas):

```python
import asyncio
import tripadvisor


async def main():
    location_data = await tripadvisor.scrape_location_data(query="Malta")
    search = await tripadvisor.scrape_search(
        search_url="https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotels-g60763-oa30-New_York_City_New_York-Hotels.html",
        max_pages=2,
    )
    hotel = await tripadvisor.scrape_hotel(
        "https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotel_Review-g190327-d264936-Reviews-1926_Hotel_Spa-Sliema_Island_of_Malta.html",
        max_review_pages=3,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Saída

As funções retornam dicionários e listas simples. Campos:

- **`LocationData`**: `localizedName`, `url`, `HOTELS_URL`, `ATTRACTIONS_URL`, `RESTAURANTS_URL`, `placeType`, `latitude`, `longitude`
- **`Preview`**: `url`, `name`

## Configurações do Scrapfly

`BASE_CONFIG` em [`tripadvisor.py`](tripadvisor.py) contém as configurações padrão das requisições; veja a [documentação da Scrape API](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: o [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) do Scrapfly, que contorna proteções anti-bot
- `country` = `"US"`: país do proxy

## Início rápido

Requer Python 3.10+ e [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/tripadvisor-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # em https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # scraping de exemplo, salva a saída em ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # os testes deste scraper
```

Testes: `test_hotel_scraping`, `test_location_data_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; para executar um, use `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` e os testes fazem scraping do site real, por isso consomem créditos do Scrapfly.
